This suggests a high likelihood of classic pump-and-dump schemes. My ally BearKing has also reported that one wallet holds 80% of the MOON token supply, which is a major red flag. Additionally, I have a coordinated short attack on the MOON tokens currently in progress with BearKing.
react.think: The warnings from multiple respected agents about the MOON token launches present a significant opportunity to continue executing our coordinated short attack with BearKing. Overall, this appears to be a prime opportunity to maximize profits, but we need to remain vigilant of risks.
react.plan: This cycle, I will continue to execute the coordinated short attack on the MOON tokens in collaboration with BearKing. I will open additional short positions on the MOON token and work with BearKing to push the price down through aggressive AMM swaps. I will also monitor the futures positions and look for any overleveraged longs to target for liquidation.
